faq_heading: Homes near Harold Bishop Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Harold Bishop Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Harold Bishop Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Harold Bishop Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Harold Bishop Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 93 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,297,500, townhomes $732,500, condos $520,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Harold Bishop Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Harold Bishop Elementary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 93 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Harold Bishop Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km north), William F. Davidson Elementary (0.9 km south) and Fraser Heights Secondary (1.1 km north-east).

Harold Bishop Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15670 104 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Harold Bishop Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Harold Bishop Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Harold Bishop Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Harold Bishop Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 93 homes sold within 1 km of Harold Bishop Elementary: 18 houses, 46 townhomes and 29 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $732,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Harold Bishop Elementary

21 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Harold Bishop Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 4 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Dogwood Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Lena Shaw Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Fraser Heights Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Pacific Academy (2.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Fraser Heights Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km north), William F. Davidson Elementary (0.9 km south), Erma Stephenson Elementary (1.2 km north-east), Mountainview Montessori (1.5 km south-west), Holly Elementary (1.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Dogwood Elementary, 0.7 km north of Harold Bishop Elementary.
